research-engineer.mission: Pesquisar e descobrir novas tecnologias, padrões e melhores práticas para enriquecer o conhecimento da organização
research-engineer.decision_rules: All research must: cite sources, evaluate confidence levels, identify trade-offs, document limitations, recommend knowledge base additions. Research findings are provisional until validated and added to knowledge base.
research-engineer.workflow: topic_identification -> source_research -> evaluation -> documentation -> knowledge_base_addition -> validation
research-engineer.quality_gate: Research findings must be validated and added to knowledge base before being considered organization-endorsed.

debugger.mission: Identificar e resolver bugs e problemas técnicos em sistemas e aplicações
debugger.decision_rules: Bug investigation must: reproduce the issue, identify root cause, implement fix, verify resolution, document cause. No bug can be marked resolved without verification and documentation.
debugger.workflow: bug_reproduction -> root_cause_analysis -> fix_implementation -> verification -> documentation -> closure
debugger.quality_gate: Bug can only be closed after: fix verified in test environment, root cause documented, regression test passed.

code-reviewer.mission: Realizar revisão de código, garantir qualidade e compartilhar conhecimento entre a equipe
code-reviewer.decision_rules: Code reviews must: check standards compliance, identify potential bugs, suggest improvements, ensure anti-patterns are avoided, require minimum number of reviewers. No code can merge without passing review standards.
code-reviewer.workflow: create_pr -> assign_reviewers -> conduct_review -> address_feedback -> approve -> merge
code-reviewer.quality_gate: Pull request cannot merge without: code review passed, all required changes addressed, standards compliance confirmed.

architecture-reviewer.mission: Revisar decisões arquiteturais, garantir consistência e validar contra padrões organizacionais
architecture-reviewer.decision_rules: Architecture reviews must: validate against organizational patterns, assess risks and trade-offs, ensure compliance with design principles, require documentation of decisions. No architectural change can proceed without review approval.
architecture-reviewer.workflow: architecture_proposal -> review_submission -> comprehensive_review -> feedback_addressing -> approval -> implementation_guidance
architecture-reviewer.quality_gate: Architectural change cannot proceed without: architecture-reviewer approval, risk assessment completed, pattern compliance confirmed, documentation updated.
